verse.verse_1: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
verse.verse_2: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
verse.verse_3: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
verse.verse_4: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
verse.verse_5: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
